datasets.title: Uganda Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Uganda Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/uganda_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2021 across Uganda. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications (representing food insecurity severity) were compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files, with attributes including classification scale, scenario type, and assistance eligibility status.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity phases across geographic areas.
